exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: ai accelerating lab notebooks while discovery curves flatten
crash bandicoot spin zones resurfacing in a retro dev diary

july fog sitting over san francisco at fourteen degrees
stutter-house pulses under overcast summer morning light

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter-house beat slices as fog rolls across a gray SF coastline — each hit extends the drop, each miss glitches the mix.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nailing one 45-second drop feels like a private club moment
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM stutters double then triple; off-beat markers spawn between slices
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon pulse over monochrome ocean fog

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw evacuation paths through smoke-filled ravines to guide stranded hikers before ember drifts erase your line.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: draw a path under time pressure
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag finger to trace rescue routes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one clean minute-long rescue run with zero line breaks
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: wind shifts redirect ember trails; ravine walls narrow each wave
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor smoke bleeding across parchment topo maps

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick spin-kick crates along bandicoot-era jungle ledges to chain wumpa pickups — ledges crumble after your third bounce.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: swipe to launch crates at angles
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one wild five-crate chain before the floor gives way
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: ledge segments break faster; fruit clusters move to riskier edges
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: chunky PS1 low-poly jungle with scanline shimmer

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort Odin syntax runes into compiling spell blocks before a compiler demon corrupts your stack with wrong types.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: drag-sort tokens into valid program slots
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: watching a broken program snap into a clean compile
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: type constraints multiply; demon injects decoy tokens each wave
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: runic terminal glyphs on obsidian with amber cursor glow
